name: bubblewrap_userns
description: Allow distribution bubblewrap to create native sandbox namespaces under restricted AppArmor without disabling host protections

storage.rationale: The control plane owns the executable-scoped Linux AppArmor policy.

apparmor_profile.rationale: Executable-scoped namespace permission; load and validate through the safeguard.

linux.reason: Host AppArmor policy cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Linux AppArmor does not apply to macOS.

windows.reason: Linux AppArmor does not apply to native Windows.

macos.evidence: Native macOS uses a different sandbox mechanism, not Linux AppArmor.

windows.evidence: Native Windows uses a different sandbox mechanism, not Linux AppArmor.
